sections.title: 1. Who processes your data
body: AZ Internacional ([TO FILL IN: legal name and company number]) is the controller of the data processed on this platform.
Data protection officer (DPO): [TO FILL IN: name and contact email].

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
body: Your school email, display name, preferred language and the record of your acceptance of these documents (date and version).
Your password, stored only as an irreversible hash (scrypt). Not even our team can read it.
Technical security data: sign-in sessions, audit records (what was done and when, with no content) and your IP address turned into a code that cannot be reversed without our secret key.
We do not collect national ID numbers (CPF, RG), address, phone or date of birth.

sections.title: 3. Why we use it
body: To let you sign in and keep the account secure; to provide educational guidance on admissions, universities and studies; to meet legal obligations.
Legal bases (Brazil's LGPD): your consent (art. 7, I); performance of the requested service (art. 7, V); fraud prevention and security (art. 7, IX).

sections.title: 4. Who we share it with
body: Only with processors needed to run the service: Supabase (database), Brevo (email delivery), Render (API server), Vercel (website) and Cloudflare (network protection). Once artificial intelligence features are enabled, content sent for analysis will go through OpenRouter and the AI models used.
Some of these processors handle data outside Brazil (international transfer, LGPD art. 33), under contractual protection clauses.
We do not sell data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: 5. How long we keep it
body: Sign-in links are valid for 15 minutes; email confirmation links, 24 hours; password reset links, 30 minutes. Their records are deleted within 30 days. Sessions last up to 7 days.
Account data and consent records: while the account exists. When you delete the account, everything is erased immediately; audit records stay for up to 12 months with no link to you.
Report card photos, once that feature exists, will be deleted right after analysis; we will keep only grades and classifications.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
body: You can confirm and access your data, correct it, request portability, withdraw consent and delete your account (LGPD art. 18).
You can delete your account yourself in Settings at any time. For other requests, contact the data protection officer.

sections.title: 7. Teenagers
body: The platform is meant for students aged 13 and older. We process data in the student's best interest (LGPD art. 14), with the student's own consent, and never use it for advertising or commercial profiling.

sections.title: 8. Security
body: Passwords, links and sessions are stored only as hashes; two-step verification secrets are encrypted; database access is restricted per row, so each student can only reach their own data.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
body: Every change creates a new dated version. When a change affects how your data is used, we will ask you to accept it again.

sections.title: 1. The service
body: AZ Internacional is an educational guidance platform for high school students. It does not guarantee admission to any program.

sections.title: 2. Your account
body: Access uses your school email. The account is personal: do not share your password, sign-in links or verification codes.

sections.title: 3. Acceptable use
body: Do not try to access other people's data, bypass usage limits, automate access without permission or use the platform for unlawful purposes.

sections.title: 4. AI-generated content
body: Parts of the content are generated by AI and may contain errors. Cut-off scores, prices and deadlines are estimates: always confirm with official sources before deciding.

sections.title: 5. Availability
body: We work to keep the service online, but interruptions may happen for maintenance or due to third-party failures.

sections.title: 6. Termination
body: You can delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts used in breach of these terms.

sections.title: 7. Governing law and contact
body: These terms are governed by Brazilian law. Venue: [TO FILL IN]. Contact: [TO FILL IN: support email].
